name: recap
description: Produce a comprehensive, bounded post-run report after a long agent session — many hours, many tickets, or thousands of lines — and write it as a self-contained HTML artifact into `.recaps/` in the repo. Answers the question a commit list cannot: what can I do now that I could not before, what needs me, and what should I not trust. Use when the user says "recap", "what did you just do", "session report", "post-task report", "summarize this session", "what changed", "I can't follow the scrollback", or at the end of any run too long to reconstruct by reading the tail of the console. Prefer running it from a FRESH session against the finished one. Do NOT use for a periodic project update to an audience (activity-report), a customer changelog, or a PR description (pr-creator).
